# Sample audit of the two RMSEs (generated by `scripts/audit_report.py`)

EKF + GNN vs NN baseline, default condition, 20 seeds. Differences are EKF − NN paired by seed, mean [95% t-interval]; the intervals describe simulation variability on one fixed traffic window. Rules: `docs/AUDIT_PROTOCOL.md`.

## Schiphol evaluation window

| RMSE | sample | n per run (EKF / NN) | EKF [m] | NN [m] | paired difference [m] | % reduction |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| scan-end | each method's own | 17,958 / 16,799 | 174.7 | 528.1 | -353.41 [-355.13, -351.70] | 66.9 |
| scan-end | common | 16,788 | 174.2 | 528.2 | -353.93 [-355.64, -352.22] | 67.0 |
| update-time | each method's own | 16,047 / 14,780 | 125.8 | 172.8 | -47.02 [-47.56, -46.49] | 27.2 |
| update-time | common | 14,714 | 125.0 | 172.6 | -47.58 [-48.07, -47.09] | 27.6 |

- Scan-end: 18,256 truth target-scans per run after warm-up. Paired by both 16,788, by the EKF only 1,169, by the baseline only 10, by neither 288. EKF RMSE on the 1,169 target-scans the baseline did not pair: 180.9 m; baseline RMSE on its 10 own-only target-scans: 385.1 m.
- Update-time: 18,237 illuminations and 16,420 target detections per run after warm-up. Used by both 14,714, by the EKF only 1,334, by the baseline only 66. EKF RMSE on its own-only samples 134.1 m; baseline on its own-only samples 215.4 m.
- Update records by reason, per run (EKF / NN): used 16,047 / 14,780, tentative track 353 / 1,171, warm-up 425 / 404, clutter detection 63 / 37.
- The scan-end difference on the common sample is 100.1% of the difference on each method's own samples. Verdict by the protocol rule: **maintained**.
- Mean time since the track's last update at the scan-end sample (common sample): EKF 2.95 s, baseline 2.93 s.
